title: Add a new behavior
summary: Behaviors are ready-made abilities you add in the Inspector (Patrol, Chase, Collectible...). Add a new one, like 'Blink', 'Orbit' or 'Magnet'.
why: Each behavior is something beginners can do without writing code.
learn: How a game engine's component system works

steps.text: Add the settings struct next to the other behaviors in engine/src/rynax/scene/components.h.
Register it (name, category "Behaviors", tooltips) in engine/src/rynax/scene/components.cpp.
Make it work each frame in engine/src/rynax/runtime/behaviors.cpp (see updateBehaviors).
Write the EasyScript that does the same job in engine/src/rynax/runtime/behavior_code.cpp, so the Code Ladder can show it.
Build and run the tests (every behavior's EasyScript is tested automatically): cmake --build build && build/bin/rynax_tests

submit: Open a pull request with a short video or GIF of your behavior. Put 'Quest: add-a-behavior' in the description.
